meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会检查你的 Slack 是否还处于"一个机器人服务所有对话"的旧状态。如果是,它会先问你想不想升级:升级的话,会为每个对话组创建独立的专属机器人,并保留原有设置、记忆和连接方式;不升级则保持原样,不做任何改动。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示需要 Slack 代理功能,或你之后随时手动要求迁移 Slack 时触发。

say.text: 检查一下当前 Slack 是旧模式还是新模式。
say.note: Claude 会执行检测,若无经典状态会提示无需迁移。

say.text: 我想留在经典模式,不迁移。
say.note: Claude 不会改动任何配置,并记录你的决定。

say.text: 开始迁移,先给我看一下计划表。
say.note: Claude 会清点现有对话和机器人,列出对照表等你确认。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can inspect the classic single-bot Slack state, ask whether to stay on classic or migrate, and if approved, provision a dedicated Slack app per agent group, copy wiring, memory and identity, verify, then switch after explicit cutover approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or on demand any time later.

say_en.text: Check if Slack is still in the classic single-bot mode.
say_en.note: Claude runs detection; if no classic state, it says there is nothing to migrate.

say_en.text: I want to stay on classic mode.
say_en.note: Claude makes no changes and records your decision.

say_en.text: Start the migration and show me the plan first.
say_en.note: Claude inventories existing groups and shows a mapping table for approval.
